command: ogdf-gml rewrite <file> (GraphIO::readGML, GraphIO::writeGML); ogdf-gml draw <file> (GraphIO::drawSVG, SVGSettings margin 16.5, width 1200px, height 900px, font family "DejaVu Sans", every other setting OGDF's default)
about: OGDF writes these files (the sheet is OGDF's own readGML / writeGML of the generated sheet) and this is OGDF's own drawing of them. drawSVG draws every label in one font size (SVGSettings, 10 px) and ignores fill patterns.
fonts: the font family "DejaVu Sans" (the repository's pinned font) is written into the SVG; rasterize.mjs draws it with visual-fonts/
svgPostprocessing: none: the SVG is OGDF's output byte for byte
